select FCPR.CASH_ID cashId, FCPR.PAY_TYPE payType, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE_VAL payCycleVal, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FCPR.CALC_RULE calcRule, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR, FIN_PRODUCT FP where FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} and FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} and FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID and FCPR.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
and FCPR.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and ( FCPR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR (FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
